description_expanded: OverviewPark Front on Camp Watercolor! 6 bikes.4 Bedrooms+2 Bunk Rooms!The SpaceNEWLY RENOVATED 2023An unforgettable 4-bedroom + 2 bunk room luxury vacation home located directly on the field at the famed Camp WaterColor. Tons of new updates for 2023. Take full advantage of the home's many exterior porches that provide a great vantage point to watch the kids play on the field or fish in the Camp Pond! You also will enjoy the close proximity to the pool and playground. With 3,200 square feet of indoor living space and 1,200 square feet of outdoor living space, there is plenty of room for multiple families to spread out. Comfort and luxury are at the heart of 349 Spartina Circle. Check availability and book with 30A Vacay today!The home features sleeping arrangements for 15 with great hideaways for some quiet time. If you must do some work while visiting the beach, 349 Spartina has you covered. The home has an office with built-in desk. But of course, don't get too comfortable behind the computer with everything that the area has to offer out the front door!Watercolor Beach is located in the heart of 30A. Within walking, biking distance to the shops and dining Seaside and Watercolor Beach have to offer. Watercolor Beach is a 499-acre community that boasts 5 community pools, tennis courts, beach access, Western Lake access and miles of walking/biking trails.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival*****Watercolor Amenities***PLEASE NOTE- A total of 12 wristbands are allowed for this property, not 15. Watercolor requires 1 wristband per person but will not provide the extra 3 wristbands due to HOA rules.Children under the age of 5 do not need a wristband. The wristbands will be located inside the property.***Watercolor does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. All carts must be reserved through their exclusive vendor Electric Cart Company******Beach Chair Rentals availalble through Watercolor Beach Service. Book Early!***SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (15):First FloorMaster Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubSecond FloorGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom (Bathroom not Attached)Bunk Room: 2 Sets of Twin Bunk Beds (4 Twin Beds), Shared Bathroom (Bathroom not Attached)Bunk Room: Twin over Full Bunk Bed, Shared BathroomHOME HIGHLIGHTS:* 6 FREE Bikes!* Directly on the field at Camp Watercolor* Bunk beds for the kids* Flat panel TVs throughout home* 2 generous living spaces* Office with built-in desk* Covered parking for 1 car* High Speed Wireless Internet* Fully equipped gourmet kitchen* A dining room table that seats 8 with 3 additional at the bar* 6 expansive porches in the front and back of the house and upstairs* Professionally Managed, 24/7 ServiceAREA ATTRACTIONS:Watercolor Beach is located in the heart of 30A. Within walking, biking distance to the shops and dining Seaside and Watercolor Beach have to offer. Watercolor Beach is a 499-acre community that boasts 5 community pools, tennis courts, beach access, Western Lake access and miles of walking/biking trails.WaterColor is also the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion. Go gourmet at Fish Out of Water, an award-winning restaurant; or sip one of many wines offered at Chan’s Wine World. Pamper yourself at a luxurious spa or pick up the perfect outfit at The Fuss boutique.- Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 4 swimming pools (Community Pool Heated Seasonally - Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens and foot paths- Nearby state parks and preservesShow less
